queries.query_text: Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (refractive index 1.52, lossless) with air incidence (index 1.0). The stack must consist of exactly one layer of lossless SiO2 (n=1.46) and one layer of los; which layer order and specific thickness combination yields the lowest mean reflectance within the evaluation budget; planar optical thin-film interference and transfer-matrix design
